free_tier.stated: Unlimited gists per account; each gist is a full Git repo. Hard block at 100 MiB per single file; 2 GB per push. Total repo size is not capped, only 10 GB on-disk is the documented recommendation.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: unmetered free downloads from gist.githubusercontent.com; docs state 'We don't limit the total size of the binary files in the release or the bandwidth used to deliver them'. No egress metering observed across repeated 60 MB pulls (~1.3-2.0 s each).

tooling: Git clone/push against gist.github.com/<id>.git, gh gist create, REST POST /gists, github.com/bharatcj/git-unlimited-storage (S3-shaped shim over a repo, MIT, 0 stars), rclone backend 'gist' does NOT exist. Use plain git plus a CDN in front.
chaining: Supports multiple gists per GitHub account, with each gist allowing files up to 100 MiB up to git push limits. Sharding partitions datasets across individual gist repositories.
limits_note: 100 MiB per file hard block (pre-receive hook); ~80 writes/min, 500/hr, 5000 REST req/hr per token; API truncates file content at 1 MB and files list at 300 unless you clone; 6 pushes/min per repo recommended.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: hook); ~80 writes/min, 500/hr, 5000 REST req/hr per token; API truncates file content at 1 MB and files list at 300 unless you clone; 6 pushes/min per repo recommended. paas

reliability_note: Push hook is strict and fires at 100 MiB; pushes into a repo already carrying hundreds of MB start failing before the per-file cap is reached, so keep each shard repo small. Read path was consistently fast and cache-friendly.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Single object size ... is enforced at 100 MB', 'Push size: This limit is enforced at 2GB', on-disk 10 GB recommendation, 15 reads/s per repo

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
